scenes.text: This is the deck builder. You tell it what deck you need... and it builds it for you, from the approved template. So it's always on brand.
scenes.action: Empty editor, zoom on the prompt box.

scenes.text: Start with the brief. Say what the deck's for, who it's for, and how many slides you want. The more concrete you are, the better the deck.
scenes.action: Type a brief: 'Eight slides for the donor steering committee on school connectivity in Kenya in 2025.'

scenes.text: Then attach your material. A PDF, a Word or PowerPoint file, an Excel sheet... or just paste a link in the brief. The deck is written from it, and your brief decides the angle.
scenes.action: Click the plus, attach an Excel file and a PDF; the chips appear.

scenes.text: If the deck needs an agenda and section dividers, turn on Chapters. If it runs straight through, just leave it off.
scenes.action: Zoom on the Chapters pill, toggle it.

scenes.text: Now press Generate. If your material leaves something open, like which sheet to use or what to headline, you'll get a few questions written for your files. Answer them, or skip.
scenes.action: Click Generate; the questions dialog opens; pick two answers; press Generate.

scenes.text: And the slides arrive, one by one. Charts use the numbers from your sheet, and the photos come from the Giga library.
scenes.action: The pill travels down into the slide bar; slides land; zoom on a chart slide.

scenes.text: Need more? Generate more slides lets you describe what's missing, and the new slides land right where they belong. Or pick a layout yourself, with Add slide.
scenes.action: Open Generate more slides, type a short request, submit; then open the Add slide picker and insert a layout.

scenes.text: To present, press play. It goes full screen, with the template's animations. Use the arrow keys to move, and Escape to leave.
scenes.action: Click the play button; the cover animates; advance twice; Escape.

scenes.text: Finally, download the deck as a PDF, a PowerPoint, or HTML. Nothing is stored on a server, so keep that HTML file... you can upload it here again and keep editing.
scenes.action: Open the Download menu, zoom on the three options.

scenes.text: Want to change some text? Just click it and type. It resizes itself to fit the layout.
scenes.action: Click a title, type a new one; zoom in.

scenes.text: Edit with AI rewrites a slide from a one-line instruction. It also shows you the same content in other layouts, so you can switch with a click. And it never touches your photos.
scenes.action: Open Edit with AI; type an instruction; hover the layout previews; pick one.

scenes.text: To replace a photo, click it. Pick one from the Giga library, upload your own, or render a live map of any country. Then drag it to reframe.
scenes.action: Click a photo; the picker opens on Library; pick a photo; drag it to reframe.

scenes.text: Icons are picked to match each card. To change one, click it and search the full icon set.
scenes.action: Click an icon card's icon; search 'school'; pick one.

scenes.text: Click a chart to open its data. Change the values, rename a series, or add a row... and the chart updates as you type.
scenes.action: Click a grouped chart; the Data panel opens; change a value; the bars move.

scenes.text: On a progress slide, click a stage to mark it as in progress. Everything before it shows as done.
scenes.action: Click the third stage; the bar fills.

scenes.text: You can add an element to a slide, or hover one and delete it. And if you change your mind, Undo brings it back.
scenes.action: Click Element; hover a card; click the cross; press Undo.

scenes.text: Drag the thumbnails to reorder the deck. When it's ready, press play to present... or download it.
scenes.action: Drag a thumbnail; end on the play button.
